values.description: A User linked from a Provider (Provider.user) that has an active UHIS Shukhee User record. The collection-level pre-request script mints a dev JWT with this as the 'sub' claim -- see the collection description for the auth mechanism. Administrator will NOT work here -- it has no linked Provider record.
